senses.gloss: m. pl. (variously corrupted) singulares, orderlies in the army; (under the later Roman emperors) imperial clerks in the provinces.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771:14">Yalk. Num. 771</cite> <he>גירה בהן הס׳</he> he set the singulares on them, and they crushed their heads with clubs (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Fustuarium); <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>סנגדודים</he>, <he>סנגרורים</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:16">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>סניגורים</he> (corr. acc.).—Y’lamd. to Num. X, 2 quot. in Ar. s. v. <he>סגנם</he>: <he>מה עשו הסניגורים</he> (corr. acc., or <he>סִגְנִיפִירִים</he> signiferi?).
